figures.title: Figure 3
figures.llm_description: Figure 3. Ferroelectric switching of a 6 nm thin In2Se3 flake transferred onto the Au/Si  substrate. a. schematic model of IP and OOP switching coupling. b. OOP phase image and c.  the corresponding IP phase image of a 6 nm thick In2Se3 flake acquired immediately after  writing two square patterns with a size of 2 µm and 1 µm by applying  -7 V and +6 V voltages  consecutively. The scale bar is 1 µm. d and e. Local ferroelectric switching loops without and  with an Au top electrode, respectively.
